row.body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says a medicinal odor came from the sprayer trial; the driver grew dizzy before the shelter message aired.
row.title: coat pocket note — at tuesday dawn

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a medicinal odor while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
